name: Richdown
description: Edit Markdown with a rich inline preview, editable tables, colored Mermaid diagrams, Gherkin boards, and Markdown lint and formatting.

settings.title: Theme
settings.description: Theme used inside the Richdown editor.

settings.title: Content width
settings.description: Width of the writing area inside the Richdown editor.

settings.title: Rich tables
settings.description: Show Markdown tables as rich editable tables.

settings.title: Mermaid diagrams
settings.description: Render Mermaid code blocks as diagrams.

settings.title: Colored Mermaid diagrams
settings.description: Apply Richdown's clearer color palette to Mermaid diagrams.

settings.title: Mermaid diagram height
settings.description: Preview height used for Mermaid diagrams.

settings.title: Gherkin boards
settings.description: Render Gherkin code blocks as BDD boards.

settings.title: Remote images
settings.description: Download images with http or https addresses so the editor can show them. Addresses on your machine or private network are never loaded.

settings.title: Lint Markdown
settings.description: Underline Markdown problems in the editor with Richdown's default rules.

settings.title: Format with Shift+Alt+F
settings.description: Format the document with Richdown's default formatter rules when Shift+Alt+F is pressed in the editor.
